result_summary.title: Webhook retry exhaustion and JSON errors in Status Page
result_summary.description: We are observing webhook retries being exhausted and receiving malformed JSON responses from the Status Page service in the ANZ production region. This is affecting 2 users and has a low business impact. We need help understanding why the JSON payloads are malformed and why retries are failing to deliver the intended notifications.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the configuration of the Central Notification Dispatcher and ensure that the JSON payload is correctly formatted.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The case report indicates that the customer is experiencing webhook retry exhaustion and receiving malformed JSON responses from the Status Page service. The evidence suggests that the issue is related to incorrect configuration, which is causing the malformed JSON payload. The affected component is the Central Notification Dispatcher, and the owning team is the Product Engineering (Frontend) team.
